# Pinned ripple and FAB source

All originals retain their Apache-2.0 headers. `sources.json` records raw URLs,
revision and SHA-256 hashes. The **current** Material3 factory imports the
`material3-ripple` module: proof and production use the `M3*` files. Files from
the older `material-ripple` module provide historical context only.
FoundationClickable.kt records the source behavior when disabling a press:
the indication node remains and the interaction source receives Cancel.

`drawing-oracle.json` is generated by `tools/androidx-ripple/snapshot.mjs` from
unchanged current drawing/radius helpers and native FloatTweenSpec/Easing.
The phase host supplies animation values and completion flags according to the
source durations; it does not execute the coroutine scheduler or platform
RippleDrawable. See the tool README for further boundaries.

`interaction-oracle.json` records unchanged native elevation/spec selection,
state-layer spec selection, FAB target calculation/interaction collection and
FloatTweenSpec samples. The scalar/event hosts preserve the original bodies;
full coroutine scheduling and platform shadows are outside this recorder.
